list_inference_endpoints: list all Inference Endpoints for a given namespace
deploy_inference_endpoint: deploy an Inference Endpoint from a Hub repository with framework, accelerator, and instance config
deploy_from_catalog: deploy an Inference Endpoint from the Hugging Face Model Catalog
update_inference_endpoint: update an existing Inference Endpoint configuration such as replicas, revision, or instance type
delete_inference_endpoint: delete an Inference Endpoint permanently with optional confirmation
